demo: Watches and first-watch setup: cancellable one-minute demonstration with real temporary HTTP checks and live firing/recovery evidence.
logs exec: Host-only foreground application launch and stream forwarding. Console Log setup authors the watch and shows the capture command; it cannot own terminal stdin or process signals.
logs ingest: Host-only stdin capture. Console authors, previews, and inspects the same log watch; daemon file and command inputs continue independently of the browser.
mcp doctor: Host integration setup boundary: local CLI and guided MCP pairing; scoped tool operations remain available through the integration UI.
mcp grants: Host integration setup boundary: local CLI and guided MCP pairing; scoped tool operations remain available through the integration UI.
mcp pair: Host integration setup boundary: local CLI and guided MCP pairing; scoped tool operations remain available through the integration UI.

mcp setup: Host integration setup boundary: local CLI and guided MCP pairing; scoped tool operations remain available through the integration UI.
status: CLI combines offline service-manager status with the authenticated Doctor view; online health is also in System.
setup: CLI host operation enables user startup and opens the local Console; no account required.
service install: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service start: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service stop: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.

service status: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
service uninstall: Host operation: manage only this installation's service; cannot depend on a running web server.
secret set: Host-only private credential write from stdin; browser and models never read stored secret values.
secret list: Host-only credential names; Console Doctor reports reference presence without values.
watch create: First-watch Console flow uses the same compiled preview and reviewed apply.
notify test: First-watch and System notification setup dialog: request permission, explain failures, retry and confirm visibility.
update check: Host updater verifies signed release metadata independently of the daemon.
update install: Host updater preserves a backup, enforces installation ownership and waits for service readiness.
update recover: Host updater reconciles its persistent journal even when the daemon cannot start.
cloud login: Explicit host connection: browser approval, private device credential, and revocation; never enrolls during local setup.
cloud status: Explicit host connection: browser approval, private device credential, and revocation; never enrolls during local setup.
cloud logout: Explicit host connection: browser approval, private device credential, and revocation; never enrolls during local setup.

cloud move status: Availability flow: explicit local preflight, selected configuration transfer, delivery confirmation, and durable reconciliation.

update configure: Host update policy: checks can be disabled; automatic compatible stable replacements require explicit opt-in and a maintenance hour.
update scheduled: Host update policy: checks can be disabled; automatic compatible stable replacements require explicit opt-in and a maintenance hour.
service host: Host operation: Windows SCM entrypoint launched by a reviewed boot service.
service boot-template: Host operation: print an administrator-reviewed boot service for an explicit dedicated account.
service repair: Host operation: preview and explicitly repair only this installation's user startup.
notification-open: OS notification activation obtains a fresh local Console handoff; no browser equivalent.
notify status: Notification setup dialog: read native permission status without prompting.
notify settings: Notification setup dialog: open notification settings on the daemon host.
server migrate: Offline host operation: apply backend-specific migrations with a separate operator role.
server init: Host operator boundary: shared server setup, process lifecycle, and offline account recovery.
server run: Host operator boundary: shared server setup, process lifecycle, and offline account recovery.
